name: Dr. Juan F. González
aboutParagraphs: Dr. Juan F. González is a dentist and orthodontics specialist, graduated from Universidad Tecnológica de México (UNITEC). He is a faculty member in craniofacial mechatronics at Universidad del Valle (Colombia), a certified Blender for Dental instructor, and a national and international speaker on digital orthodontics, with published research in journals including the American Journal of Orthodontics, Ortodoncia Actual and Kieferorthopädie.

He maintains a private dental practice in Cuenca, Ecuador, and founded Cursos Odonto 3D in 2021, an academy that has trained thousands of dental professionals worldwide in digital dentistry: 3D printing, surgical guides, CAD/CAM design and digital lab workflows.

In this catalog, Dr. González contributed two templates for dental clinics, Dental patient assistant on WhatsApp and Dental assistant for Instagram DMs: the front-desk playbook his academy gives clinics, packaged as prompts.
